conclusion: The demonstrated asymmetric bag/dropout loophole belongs to our scratch-CNN pipeline. It must not be presented as a diagnosed cause of the historical EfficientNet failures.
limits: Source inspection only. Historical checkpoint and raw data protocol are not re-evaluated by this finding.
observed: Trainer constructs build_bce_loss(pos_weight); train and validation call the same BCEWithLogitsLoss on segment logits/labels. Its loss is not our positive-max/negative-mean recording-bag objective.
